question: Which exact-target LVGL v9 functions safely place a page-owned image behind stock content and make stock surfaces transparent?
callsite_evidence: move-to-index compatibility veneer 0x0C5891F8 is used by the stock foreground path with child_count - 1; passing 0 selects the back-most child
direct LVGL implementation 0x0C13C064 contains lv_obj_move_to_index and lv_obj_tree.c diagnostics and performs child-array relocation plus invalidation
bg-opa helper 0x0C108048 loads property 0x1D, forwards opacity as value and selector as argument 4 to 0x0C107464
LVGL v9 style metadata confirms low property 29 is BG_OPA, 48 is BORDER_WIDTH and 50 is BORDER_OPA
control_flow_evidence: stock page content, title and list-row objects are created and styled on the target-private UI owner thread
the style helper writes a local style property without accessing private object offsets
ownership_analysis: All functions borrow page-owned live LVGL objects and neither retain nor free them. Calls must remain on the page owner thread before parent teardown.
unsafe_assumptions: No device probe has yet exercised transparent stock rows over a full-screen BIN background
recommended_probe: On a disposable player page, create a root child background, move it to index 0, clear BG_OPA and border width on content/title/outer rows, exercise touch, change tracks, pause/resume and destroy.
